name: Führerhauptquartier Wolfsschanze, East Prussia
description: 30 December 1943. Hitler, Himmler, Kaltenbrunner, Best, von Hanneken, Pancke. Hitler rules that trials "would only create martyrs" and orders murder for murder, sabotage for sabotage against purely Danish targets.
notes: Documented from the Best trial transcript. See research: wolfsschanze_30_dec_1943.
